name: 만독불침의 서
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: single fantasy inventory pixel-art sprite. First input image is edit target (or original design to restore). Preserve current pixel-art style, coarse square clusters, dark stepped outlines, palette and proportions except explicitly requested changes. Redesign the western metal-clasp spell tome as an EAST ASIAN WUXIA SECRET MARTIAL-ARTS MANUAL (비급). Traditional stitched/thread-bound paper booklet with visible ivory thread stitches along left binding, dark jade-green cloth/paper cover, stacked cream paper edges, narrow vertical ivory title slip with a few dark abstract brushlike pixel marks (no legible words required), small vermilion square seal. Keep subtle poison theme with restrained green snake/leaf emblem near lower cover. Remove heavy bronze corner guards, gemstone clasp and bulky western book fittings. Slight3/4 view, square2x2 item footprint. Match original coarse block pixels, dark outlines, few shading colors. Transparent background.
Return exactly ONE item. No text labels, watermark, grid or backdrop. Preserve real alpha transparency; no black background. No blurring or antialias smoothing. Full object with safe transparent margins. Inventory footprint (# occupied, . empty), top-to-bottom: ##/##
